name: sdd-plugin-suite
description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) plugin suite — core workflows, frontend, backend, and utility skills from planning to implementation.

plugins.name: sdd
plugins.description: Core SDD workflow - spec-driven development from planning to Jira export. Includes deep-spec, spec-to-prd, prd-to-task, feature-tdd, feature-to-jira, bug-analyzer, and plan-critic skills.

plugins.name: sdd-frontend
plugins.description: Frontend development skills - UI design, enhancement, and Playwright-based testing. Includes frontend-design, frontend-enhancement, frontend-init, playwright-task-tester, and ui-heuristic-click-audit skills.

plugins.name: sdd-utilty
plugins.description: Utility skills for compressed communication, session knowledge handoff, PRD generation, and AI code quality review. Includes caveman, handoff, handoff-resume, init-feature, ask-first, and code-slop-review skills.

plugins.name: sdd-backend
plugins.description: Backend development skills for API, database, and server-side logic with unit testing. Includes bug-fix-backend and backend-enhancement skills.
